x: …their blessedness and reward, but by some voluntary condescension on God’s part, which He hath been pleased to express by way of covenant
and the infinite distance that is between us and God, whom, by them, we can neither profit, nor satisfy for the debt of our former sins
…have attained the reward of life but by some voluntary condescension on God’s part, which He has been pleased to express by way of covenant
endued them with living, reasonable, and immortal souls
